body:
# Venenatis

Weakest to crush. Ursine chainmace is strongest (Wilderness mace); Viggora's is the budget alt. Ranged stays competitive near the exit.

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Transportation
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
Venenatis is located in the [[Silk Chasm]], which is a lair in the far east of the Wilderness at level 35.

* A [[Wilderness crabs teleport]] is the fastest way to reach Venenatis, and will teleport you to the dark crab fishing spot just south-east of the lair.
* With 90 [[Magic]], players on the [[Ancient spellbook]] can use [[Annakarl Teleport]], which will teleport them into the [[Demonic Ruins]]. Simply go south-east of your location after arriving. Be wary of [[PK'ers]] upon arrival.
** Alternatives to this also include the [[Annakarl teleport (tablet)|Annakarl teleport]] tablet and a portal attuned to Annakarl. Be wary of PK'ers on arrival; if using the house portal, you should have a [[scrying pool]] to check the area first.
* With 57 [[Woodcutting]], players can make a [[Waka canoe]] and use it to go to the [[Wilderness]]. Go east of your location past Vet'ion's rest and the poisonous spiders.
* A [[games necklace]] to teleport to the [[Corporeal Beast]]'s lair, exit the cave then run north-east.
* Players who have completed the Hard [[Wilderness Diary]] can utilize the Wilderness obelisks to teleport to levels 19, 35, or 55 to get closer to the Silk Chasm.
* Players who have completed the Hard or Elite [[Wilderness Diary]] can use the [[Wilderness Sword 4|Wilderness Sword]] to teleport to the [[Fountain of Rune]] and run south-west to Venenatis.

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Attacks
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
Venenatis has many attacks that she uses against her target. 

*[[Melee]] attack: She simply lunges at the player
*Ranged attack: Launches green spit at players
*Magic attack: Launches webs at players
*Sticky Web: Venenatis will occasionally deploy a sticky web at a player, sending a white-blue web at the target's location. It will then expand into a 7x5 AoE - while in this web, any player caught in it will take rapid hits of 3 damage, have their prayer drained by 3, and run energy by 10.
**Note that [[aranea boots]] will only negate the first tick of damage taken from the web attack. Because of this, it is not recommended to use them at Venenatis due to the extremely small benefit they will provide, while adding unnecessary risk.
*Spiderlings: Venenatis will occasionally call some [[Venenatis' Spiderling (monster)|spiderlings]] to assist her in battle. While fairly weak, they will drain prayer on every hit regardless if prayed against or hits. They will also increase her damage and allow her to hit through prayers if left alive.  Thrall damage is reduced while spiderlings are alive.

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Overview
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
[[File:Fighting Venenatis.png|thumb|300px|A trio of players fighting Venenatis.]]

Venenatis can attack with all three forms of combat. While she will only use one combat style at a time, players in melee distance will instead only be attacked by melee. Like [[Vet'ion]], she is weakest to crush.

She will begin the fight using 8 range attacks, followed by 8 magic attacks, all while moving position every 4 attacks. She will spawn spiderlings on the 1st range attack in cycle, and deploy her web attack on the 3rd mage attack in the cycle.  This pattern will repeat until Venenatis is defeated.

All players who enter the arena will appear to the north, so it is recommended to hang south as much as possible to escape player killers, as she is no longer under level 30 Wilderness following the [[Update:Wilderness_Boss_Rework|Wilderness boss rework]]. This does not apply to the weaker variant of the boss, [[Spindel]], as her lair is still below level 30 Wilderness and can be teleported out of directly.

Players should avoid the webs at all costs, as their ability to drain run energy will prevent them from escaping from player killers. 

The web can be positioned safely by standing on the outskirt of the arena on the 3rd magic attack to help prevent accidentally walking into the web. 

The spiderlings should be killed as soon as they spawn to prevent them from empowering her too much; fortunately, they only have 5 health and can be killed in one hit by any combat style.

* [[Dart|Darts]] or [[Throwing knives]] can quickly eliminate individual spiderlings.
* Any tier of [[Chinchompa (weapon)|Chinchompa]] can eliminate multiple spiderlings with a well-placed shot (Ensure PK Skull prevention is activated).
* Players with 70+ Magic and [[Ancient Magicks]] can use a burst spell with [[Blighted ancient ice sack|Blighted ancient ice sacks]] to eliminate multiple spiderlings at once.

*

You should aim to take 4 valuable items you wish to keep if killed by another player, usually Craw's bow, Necklace of rupture, Slayer helmet (i) (on-task), and Dinh's bulwark provide the best balance of damage against Venenatis and survivability against other players.

** Note that setting your [[Combat Options]] to defensive provides an invisble +5 level boost to your defence and also reduces non-pvp damage by 20% (with the Bulwark equipped) [Prevents attacking]
** The shield's animation will play when the wielder fails to block an incoming attack. This can alert the wielder to heal as it occurs prior to the hit landing.

* [[Ranging potion]]
* [[Anti-venom]]/[[Sanfew serum]](s) — cures/prevents venom from player killers and poisonous spiders in the [[Escape Caves]]
* [[Blighted super restores]]

* [[Saradomin brews]] — more expensive outlast healing, combo eating with hard food is invaluable
* [[Royal seed pod]] — if not bringing a charged [[amulet of glory]] or [[ring of wealth]]
* [[Wilderness crabs teleport]], [[Annakarl teleport (tablet)]], or [[Wilderness sword 4]]'s [[fountain of rune]] — reach the [[Silk Chasm]] faster

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Example melee setup
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
The aim is to maximise damage output while minimising risk. The protected items should be items that either grant very high melee strength bonus increases or a large percentage damage increase like the [[Slayer helmet (i)]]. The [[ultor ring]] and the [[avernic defender]] both give major buffs to the player's offensive stats, and can be used along with cheaper items to deal high damage with limited risk. Items that can be easily replaced such as [[barrows gloves]], [[amulet of strength]], and [[black dragonhide armour|dragonhide armour]] are wise choices as the chance of dying is fairly high. 

If on a [[boss task]], the player can use [[bracelet of slaughter]] to extend the task. This will affect damage output, but lower the player's risk slightly. 

{{Equipment
|align = right
|head = Slayer helmet (i)
|cape = Mixed hide cape
|neck = Amulet of strength
|ammo = Rada's blessing 4
|weapon = Ursine chainmace
|torso = Black d'hide body
|legs = Black d'hide chaps
|shield = Avernic defender
|gloves = Barrows gloves
|boots = Mixed hide boots
|ring = Ultor ring
}}

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Items protected:
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
* [[Ultor ring]]
* [[Ursine chainmace]]{{efn|name=mace}} / [[Viggora's chainmace]]{{efn|With around 1500 revenant ether. Do not overcharge the mace, as all charges are lost on death|name=mace}} — This adds between {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Revenant ether|1100}}}} and {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Revenant ether|1500}}}} to the value risked, as it uses [[revenant ether]] for charges. The DPS difference from [[Inquisitor's mace]] is [https://dps.osrs.wiki?id=WizardMustyLightbearer significant].
* [[Avernic defender]] (Can be switched out to [[Book of War]] in order to use [[Dinh's bulwark]], as this can be used to AoE minions and survive attacks from PKers)
* [[Slayer helmet (i)]] if on a slayer task

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Items lost:
Example ranged setup
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
The [[Masori body (f)]] can be traded out for a [[Black d'hide body]] and [[Dinh's bulwark]] for survivability and AoE damage against the spiderlings. Ranged allows the player to more easily damage the enemy for the duration of the entire fight, and stand closer to the door where it may be more safe. In lower risk gear, the damage output of the bow doesn't match up to melee; the difference is [https://dps.osrs.wiki?id=KebbitRobberyTrap significant]. 

Additionally, due to the bows faster attack speed, the player consumes more revenant ether than if they were using melee. This is compounded by the longer fights with more hits. Because of this, extra ether is risked and used for slower fights, reducing potential profits.

As with melee, the player can use [[bracelet of slaughter]] to extend the task, if on a boss task for Venenatis. This will affect the player's accuracy and magic defence slightly.

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Transportation
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
Spindel is located in the [[Web Chasm]], which is a lair located in the ruins north of the [[Graveyard of Shadows]] in level 29 [[Wilderness]].

* [[Carrallanger teleport (tablet)|Graveyard of Shadows teleport]], then run north.
* Teleport to [[Ferox Enclave]] and run north past [[Green dragon|green dragons]], or head north-east around the graveyard.
* Teleport to the level 26 [[Revenant Caves]] entrance with a [[revenant cave teleport]] and run east.
* With the [[Hunter cape]], teleport to the [[Black chinchompa (Hunter)|black chinchompas]] and run south east.
* Take a [[canoe]] to the [[wilderness pond]] and run south east.
* A [[games necklace]] to teleport to the [[Corporeal Beast's Lair|Corporeal Beast's lair]], exit the cave then run north-west.

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Attacks
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
Spindel has many attacks that she uses against her target. 

*Melee attack: She simply lunges at the player. This is the only normal attack she will use if the player is within melee distance.
*Ranged attack: Launches green spit at players.
*Magic attack: Launches webs at players.
*Sticky Web: Spindel will occasionally deploy a sticky web at a player, sending a white-blue web at the target's location. It will then expand into a 7x5 AoE - while in this web, any player caught in it will take rapid hits of 3 damage, have their prayer drained by 3, and run energy by 10.
**Note that [[aranea boots]] will only negate the first tick of damage taken from the web attack.
*Spiderlings: Spindel will occasionally call some [[Spindel's Spiderling|spiderlings]] to assist her in battle. While fairly weak, they will drain prayer on every hit regardless if the attack does damage or if [[protection prayers]] are active. They will also increase her damage and allow her to hit through prayers if left alive. Player and thrall damage is slightly reduced while spiderlings are alive. Currently, spiderlings cannot spawn east of Spindel's location for reasons unknown.

Overview
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
[[File:Spindel.png|thumb|width=300x300|Spindel's in-game appearance.]]
Spindel can attack with all three forms of combat. While she will only use one combat style at a time, players in melee distance will instead only be attacked by melee. Like [[Calvar'ion]], she is weakest to crush.

She will begin the fight using 8 ranged attacks, followed by 8 magic attacks, all while moving position every 4 attacks. She will spawn spiderlings on the 1st ranged attack in cycle, and deploy her web attack on the 3rd mage attack in the cycle.  This pattern will repeat until Spindel is defeated.

Players who enter the arena will appear to the north, so always keep an eye out for PKers and teleport or run to the exit if needed. 

Players should avoid the webs at all costs, as their ability to drain run energy will prevent them from escaping from player killers. The web can be positioned safely by standing on the outskirt of the arena on the 3rd magic attack to help prevent accidentally walking into the web. 

The spiderlings should be killed as soon as they spawn to prevent them from empowering her too much; fortunately, they only have 5 health and can be killed in one hit by any combat style.

* Any tier of [[Chinchompa (weapon)|chinchompa]] can eliminate multiple spiderlings with a well-placed shot as well as damage Spindel's south-west tile, (Ensure PK Skull prevention is activated).
* [[Blisterwood stake]]s, [[dart]]s, or [[throwing knives]] can quickly eliminate individual spiderlings. Blisterwood stakes have longer range than darts and knives, and can be reclaimed from a gravestone for free on PvP death due to being untradeable.
* Players with 70+ [[Magic]] and [[Ancient Magicks]] can use a burst spell with [[Blighted ancient ice sack|blighted ancient ice sacks]] to eliminate multiple spiderlings at once.
